blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Far Eastern University-DN Steel dominated the winless Armed Forces of the Philippines, 25-16, 25-20, 25-10, to complete back-to-back wins in less than 24 hours in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Thursday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Mikko Espartero made his tournament debut after missing their first six games due to an ankle injury and delivered a game-high 10 points for as FEU gained share of third place with Alpha Insurance with identical 5-2 records. Xandrex Ragusta and Amet Bituin contributed nine points each for the Tamaraws, while Dryx Saavedra added eight points. “The boys really worked hard […]...
